component.name: SideMenu
component.script:
sub init() m.menuList = m.top.findNode("menuList") m.menuList.observeField("itemSelected", "onItemSelected") m.top.observeField("focusRequested", "onFocusRequested") buildMenuContent() end sub
sub buildMenuContent() content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each title in [ "On Demand", "Live TV", "Settings" ] item = content.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = title end for m.menuList.content = content end sub
sub onFocusRequested() m.menuList.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onItemSelected(event as object) index = event.getData() if index = 0 m.top.viewRequested = "onDemand" else if index = 1 m.top.viewRequested = "liveTV" else if index = 2 m.top.settingsRequested = true end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "left" or key = "back" or key="right" m.top.closeRequested = true return true end if return true end function
